name: signal_stft
expr: s = stft(x, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'twosided'); s_rows = size(s, 1); s_cols = size(s, 2); s11_re = real(s(1,1)); s11_im = imag(s(1,1)); s33_1_re = real(s(33,1)); s32_3_re = real(s(32,3)); s32_3_im = imag(s(32,3)); s16_7_re = real(s(16,7)); s16_7_im = imag(s(16,7)); sc = stft(x, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'centered'); sc11_re = real(sc(1,1)); sc11_im = imag(sc(1,1)); sc33_1_re = real(sc(33,1)); sc33_1_im = imag(sc(33,1)); so = stft(x, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'onesided'); so_rows = size(so, 1); so_cols = size(so, 2); so11_re = real(so(1,1)); xr = real(istft(s, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'twosided')); xr_inner_err = max(abs(x(64:end-64) - xr(64:end-64)')); xr_len = length(xr); xrc = real(istft(sc, 'Window', w, 'OverlapLength', 32, 'FFTLength', 64, 'FrequencyRange', 'centered')); xrc_inner_err = max(abs(x(64:end-64) - xrc(64:end-64)'));
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox stft / istft — short-time Fourier transform and inverse. stft loops windowed frames of length M, zero-pads to FFTLength, and runs an FFT per frame; output rows = FFTLength (twosided / centered) or FFTLength/2+1 (onesided). istft mirrors via overlap-add with the same synthesis window and per-sample window² normalization — for COLA-compliant configurations (hann/periodic with 50%/75% overlap) the round-trip is bit-exact on interior samples (max-err ~5e-16). Default frequency range is 'centered' (matches MATLAB R2019b+). Centered uses MATLAB's bin rotation Sd[k] = Fd[(k + N/2 + 1) mod N] for even N (Nyquist at end), (k + (N+1)/2) mod N for odd N — verified bit-equal vs MATLAB on the canonical sin probe. All three range modes round-trip via istft to ulp. KNOWN GAPS: fs / time-axis / [s, f, t] multi-output; multi-channel matrix input. Octave 11.1.0 ships stft / istft in the signal package (not core).
